parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without field lists, type kinds, or any populated structural signal, there is no grounded evidence on which to base an actionable recommendation. The two names surfaced in the cluster_id — `Discogs.SearchResult` and `Discogs.SearchResult.CodingKeys` — are a Swift type and its nested `CodingKeys` enum, which is the standard Codable pattern; a nested `CodingKeys` enum being a structural subset of its enclosing type is intentional and idiomatic, not a refactor opportunity.
